scope: Joint autumn anchor-day displacement and conditional Fajr-factor feasibility diagnosis across all 28 existing city-years. Research only; no deployment, prediction accuracy claim, or external data acquisition.
selection: Freeze the 28 city-years, reference-model-selected core affine segments, autumn anchor indices, and daily adjusted sunrise/sunset from the pinned existing reports. Evaluate the common anchor displacement d in {-3,-2,-1,0,1,2,3} for every city-year; evaluate all shifts for all city-years, without per-city shift selection. At shifted date b+d, project each event's compatible affine lines using public affine_value. Compute the necessary conditional factor k=(R-Bf)/(Bi-S), retaining only physical-domain constraints R-Bf>0 and 0<Bi-S<N where N=1440+R-S. Preserve every empty status, including tie-only and positive conflicts. Report k=18/16 and k=1 membership per case; compute universal intersections including empty cases, separately for trim 0, 1, and 2. Trim 0 is primary; trims 1 and 2 are sensitivity analyses only. Also independently verify membership by testing A intersect kD, where A=R-Bf and D=Bi-S.
interpretation: This is a necessary-condition diagnostic with independently free Fajr and Isha affine slopes. A nonempty factor interval or universal intersection does not establish forecast accuracy or a Diyanet rule. Shifts are diagnostic candidate dates, not recommendations or deployment choices.
correction: For every common displacement d, select the adjusted sunrise R and sunset S from the existing daily row at index b+d, and compute N=1440+R-S from that same row. Do not reuse row[b] horizons. Keep all frozen affine line segments and all other choices in plan.json unchanged.
formula: For each common d and frozen anchor b, project endpoints at x=b+d; set A=R-Bf, D=Bi-S, N=1440+R-S, k=A/D subject to A>0 and 0<D<N.

publicExport.scope: Every shift/case factor interval and membership retained; input projections remain in private report.
